plan: Deep-copy and validate the recursive workspace tree, indexing unique item IDs and enforcing container-specific fields.
Traverse the tree deterministically for word counting, unresolved-marker collection, outline rendering, and copied serialization.
Implement relocation as a validate-first transaction: resolve source and destination, reject invalid indices and cycles, then remove and insert only after every check passes.
mechanisms: Recursive tree traversal over workspace, section, and group item lists
Regular expressions that remove exact marker tokens before counting words
Set-based marker deduplication followed by lexicographic sorting
Defensive deep copies on input and output
